scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @classroom/shared && concurrently --names shared,server,web --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --workspace @classroom/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @classroom/server" "npm run dev --workspace @classroom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @classroom/shared && npm run build --workspace @classroom/server && npm run build --workspace @classroom/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm --prefix e2e test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @classroom/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix e2e run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js shared server web e2e --max-warnings=0
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && bash scripts/check-diagrams.sh
